company.name: CDW Corporation
company.sector: Information Technology · IT solutions distribution and services
company.description: CDW distributes and integrates multi-brand information technology products and services for business, government, education and healthcare customers in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada. Its 2025 Form 10-K reported more than 250,000 customers and approximately 14,800 coworkers.

coverage.label: Curated public-source coverage
coverage.note: This is a sourced sample of CDW's network, not a complete customer or supplier roster. CDW reports more than 1,000 vendor partners and more than 250,000 customers. Many customers are confidential. Named sell-side analysts are omitted because no current primary-source roster was verified. Ownership snapshots are dated filings, not real-time positions.
